description: This file defines an abstract class 'GrainPersistenceTestsRunner' used as a base for running persistence-related tests on Orleans grains, including functional and performance tests. It interacts with Orleans testing infrastructure, grains, and clusters, and contains test methods for CRUD operations, silo restarts, and performance benchmarks.

classes.name: GrainPersistenceTestsRunner
classes.description: Abstract base class providing a framework for testing persistence of Orleans grains, including CRUD, restart, and performance tests.

methods.description: Test method to verify that grains have no state before write operations.
